findings.reason: §16 should route doccheck's and the contract checks' h2 walks through the hoisted enumerator (or state why they differ), otherwise the "one home" claim is not delivered and the digest's section boundary can drift from the collapse's span it must match.
findings.text: §16 hoists `_authored_section_headings` (BeautifulSoup) into reckon/_store.py "beside the extent recognisers" and calls the regex pair `_section_heading`/`_section_body_end` for the span, but reckon/_store.py already walks every h2 by regex in `landed_section_ids` (line 1052) and reckon/doccheck.py enumerates authored headings by soup at lines 985 and 1026, so the same document is now recognised by two walking styles in one file and a fourth spelling across the package

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §16 keeps one identity (`plan_fingerprint` recomposed as the digest of a sorted section set plus a document unit) and one enumerator, hiding per-section extraction, the section-digest set, the coverage question and the whole-document recomposition behind that owner plus a single coverage predicate, rather than a module of wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §16 hoists the soup-based `_authored_section_headings` into reckon/_store.py as "one home", but authored-section identity is already enumerated by regex in that file (`landed_section_ids`, reckon/_store.py:1052) and by soup in reckon/doccheck.py:985 and :1026, so the hoist adds a fourth recogniser instead of consolidating.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1475, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §16 states "one public definition is added, the coverage predicate the gate and the sweep read; nothing is retired, because the identity digest and the prose walk keep their names and gain a mode", and it reuses the existing plan-review-missing refusal family, so the section accounts for its added surface as the rule requires.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §3 states it extends the build skill's reuse-map rule rather than adding a parallel check, and §16 names the exact owners it extends (`plan_fingerprint` and `_authored_prose` in reckon/crew/plan_review.py, the span pair `_section_heading`/`_section_body_end` and `landed_section_ids` in reckon/_store.py, `_fingerprint_forms` for the identity transition), every one of which exists at the cited path.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one new public definition (the coverage predicate) carries the gate's and the sweep's coverage question, and §16 justifies changing the fingerprint's definition (one identity, section digests beside it) rather than wrapping the existing reader in a second one.
